blocks.prompt: 1 (i) Sketch the graph of the following functions using the method of factorization: \(y = 3(x + 1)(x - 1)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sketch ka sawal hai. Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke function factor form \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein hai ya laana parega.
Is mein do alag roots hain, is liye 1.1 ka Case-I lagega.
Humein chaar cheezein chahiyein: x-intercepts, vertex (roots ke bilkul darmiyan), khulne ki direction (\(a\) ke sign se) aur y-intercept.
Yeh chaar cheezein graph ka dhancha (skeleton) bana deti hain.
Phir symmetry se ek extra point le kar smooth curve banayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = 3(x + 1)(x - 1)\).
Maloom karna: is function ka graph sketch karna.
Tareeqa: 1.1 ka Case-I (\(h \ne k\)): intercepts, \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par vertex, \(a\) ka sign, aur y-intercept. Yeh tareeqa is liye aasan hai ke factor form mein roots seedhe nazar aate hain.

Factor form
Function pehle se factor form mein hai, aur \(a = 3\).
Kyun: is method mein \(a\), \(h\) aur \(k\) saaf nazar aane chahiyein; yahan woh seedhe parh sakte hain.

Step 1: x-intercepts
\[x + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -1\]
\[x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
Kyun: x-axis par \(y = 0\) hota hai, aur product tab hi zero hota hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. Is liye har factor ko zero rakha.
Dhyan dein: factor ke andar ka sign root mein ulta ho jata hai.

Step 2: vertex
\[x = \dfrac{-1 + 1}{2} = 0\]
\[y = 3(0 + 1)(0 - 1) = -3\]
Vertex: \((0, -3)\).
Kyun: parabola apni axis ke dono taraf ek jaisa hota hai, is liye vertex dono roots ke bilkul darmiyan (average par) aata hai. Phir wohi \(x\) function mein rakh kar height nikali.

Step 3: kinaron ka rawaiya
\(a = 3 > 0\), is liye \(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y \to +\infty\): parabola upar khulta hai (seedha pyala).
Kyun: bari \(|x|\) par \(x^{2}\) wala term haavi hota hai, aur us ka sign \(a\) ka sign hai.

Step 4: y-intercept
\[y = 3(0 + 1)(0 - 1) = -3\]
y-intercept: \((0, -3)\).
Kyun: y-axis par \(x = 0\) hota hai, wohi rakha. Dhyan dein: y-intercept aur vertex ko aapas mein na milayein; y-intercept hamesha \(x = 0\) par hota hai, jab ke vertex axis of symmetry par.

Sketch
In points ko plot karein aur smooth U-shape curve se jor dein (answer figure dekhiye). Yahan y-intercept aur vertex ek hi point hain, kyun ke roots \(-1\) aur \(1\) y-axis ke dono taraf barabar faasle par hain, to axis of symmetry khud y-axis hai.
Kyun: intercepts, vertex aur direction mil kar parabola ko tay kar dete hain. Har important point par coordinates zaroor likhein; exam mein inhi ke marks hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[y(2) = 3(3)(1) = 9\]
\[y(-2) = 3(-1)(-3) = 9 \;\checkmark\]
Symmetry \(x = 0\) ke gird: \((2, 9)\) aur \((-2, 9)\) ek doosre ka aaina hain, dono ki height barabar aani chahiye.
blocks.final_answer: Upar khulne wala parabola: x-intercepts \((-1, 0)\), \((1, 0)\); vertex aur y-intercept dono \((0, -3)\).

answer_figure.alt: Upward parabola y = 3(x + 1)(x minus 1) cutting the x-axis at (minus 1, 0) and (1, 0), with vertex and y-intercept at (0, minus 3).
answer_figure.caption: Answer sketch for Exercise 1.1 Question 1 (i): y = 3(x + 1)(x − 1) (original drawing; the answer key prints a matching graph)

blocks.prompt: 1 (ii) Sketch the graph of the following functions using the method of factorization: \(f(x) = -2(x - 1)(x - 2)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sketch ka sawal hai. Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke function factor form \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein hai ya laana parega.
Is mein do alag roots hain, is liye 1.1 ka Case-I lagega.
Humein chaar cheezein chahiyein: x-intercepts, vertex (roots ke bilkul darmiyan), khulne ki direction (\(a\) ke sign se) aur y-intercept.

Phir symmetry se ek extra point le kar smooth curve banayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = -2(x - 1)(x - 2)\).
Maloom karna: is function ka graph sketch karna.
Tareeqa: 1.1 ka Case-I (\(h \ne k\)): intercepts, \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par vertex, \(a\) ka sign, aur y-intercept. Yeh tareeqa is liye aasan hai ke factor form mein roots seedhe nazar aate hain.

Factor form
Function pehle se factor form mein hai, aur \(a = -2\).
Kyun: is method mein \(a\), \(h\) aur \(k\) saaf nazar aane chahiyein; yahan woh seedhe parh sakte hain.

Step 1: x-intercepts
\[x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
\[x - 2 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 2\]
Kyun: x-axis par \(y = 0\) hota hai, aur product tab hi zero hota hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. Is liye har factor ko zero rakha.
Dhyan dein: factor ke andar ka sign root mein ulta ho jata hai.

Step 2: vertex
\[x = \dfrac{1 + 2}{2} = \dfrac{3}{2}\]
\[f\left(\tfrac{3}{2}\right) = -2\left(\tfrac{1}{2}\right)\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{1}{2}\]
Vertex: \(\left(\frac{3}{2}, \frac{1}{2}\right) = (1.5, 0.5)\).
Kyun: parabola apni axis ke dono taraf ek jaisa hota hai, is liye vertex dono roots ke bilkul darmiyan (average par) aata hai. Phir wohi \(x\) function mein rakh kar height nikali.

Step 3: kinaron ka rawaiya
\(a = -2 < 0\), is liye \(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y \to -\infty\): parabola neeche khulta hai (ulta pyala).
Kyun: bari \(|x|\) par \(x^{2}\) wala term haavi hota hai, aur us ka sign \(a\) ka sign hai.

Step 4: y-intercept
\[f(0) = -2(0 - 1)(0 - 2)\]
\[= -2(-1)(-2) = -4\]
y-intercept: \((0, -4)\).
Kyun: y-axis par \(x = 0\) hota hai, wohi rakha. Dhyan dein: y-intercept aur vertex ko aapas mein na milayein; y-intercept hamesha \(x = 0\) par hota hai, jab ke vertex axis of symmetry par.

Sketch
In points ko plot karein aur smooth U-shape curve se jor dein (answer figure dekhiye). Yahan \(a < 0\) hai, is liye vertex sab se ooncha point hai; parabola ulta pyala hai jo sirf thora sa x-axis ke upar aata hai.
Kyun: intercepts, vertex aur direction mil kar parabola ko tay kar dete hain. Har important point par coordinates zaroor likhein; exam mein inhi ke marks hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(3) = -2(2)(1) = -4 \;\checkmark\]
Symmetry \(x = \frac{3}{2}\) ke gird: \((0, -4)\) axis se \(\frac{3}{2}\) unit left hai, to \(\frac{3}{2}\) unit right yani \((3, -4)\) bhi graph par hona chahiye.
blocks.final_answer: Neeche khulne wala parabola: x-intercepts \((1, 0)\), \((2, 0)\); vertex \((1.5, 0.5)\); y-intercept \((0, -4)\).

answer_figure.alt: Downward parabola f(x) = minus 2(x minus 1)(x minus 2) cutting the x-axis at (1, 0) and (2, 0), highest point (1.5, 0.5), y-intercept (0, minus 4).
answer_figure.caption: Answer sketch for Exercise 1.1 Question 1 (ii): f(x) = −2(x − 1)(x − 2) (original drawing; the answer key prints a matching graph)

blocks.prompt: 1 (iii) Sketch the graph of the following functions using the method of factorization: \(y = (2x - 1)(2x + 1)\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sketch ka sawal hai. Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke function factor form \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein hai ya laana parega.
Is mein do alag roots hain, is liye 1.1 ka Case-I lagega.
Humein chaar cheezein chahiyein: x-intercepts, vertex (roots ke bilkul darmiyan), khulne ki direction (\(a\) ke sign se) aur y-intercept.
Yeh chaar cheezein graph ka dhancha (skeleton) bana deti hain.
Phir symmetry se ek extra point le kar smooth curve banayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = (2x - 1)(2x + 1)\).
Maloom karna: is function ka graph sketch karna.
Tareeqa: 1.1 ka Case-I (\(h \ne k\)): intercepts, \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par vertex, \(a\) ka sign, aur y-intercept. Yeh tareeqa is liye aasan hai ke factor form mein roots seedhe nazar aate hain.

Factor form mein likhein
\[y = 2\left(x - \tfrac{1}{2}\right) \cdot 2\left(x + \tfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
\[y = 4\left(x - \tfrac{1}{2}\right)\left(x + \tfrac{1}{2}\right)\]
Kyun: har bracket se 2 bahar nikala taa ke shakal \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) ban jaye; is liye \(a = 4\) hai, 1 nahi.
Dhyan dein: factor form mein \(x\) ka coefficient 1 hona chahiye, tab hi \(a\) sahi nazar aata hai.

Step 1: x-intercepts
\[2x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = \tfrac{1}{2}\]
\[2x + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -\tfrac{1}{2}\]
Kyun: x-axis par \(y = 0\) hota hai, aur product tab hi zero hota hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. Is liye har factor ko zero rakha.
Dhyan dein: factor ke andar ka sign root mein ulta ho jata hai.

Step 2: vertex
\[x = \dfrac{-\frac{1}{2} + \frac{1}{2}}{2} = 0\]
\[y = (0 - 1)(0 + 1) = -1\]
Vertex: \((0, -1)\).
Kyun: parabola apni axis ke dono taraf ek jaisa hota hai, is liye vertex dono roots ke bilkul darmiyan (average par) aata hai. Phir wohi \(x\) function mein rakh kar height nikali.

Step 3: kinaron ka rawaiya
\(a = 4 > 0\), is liye \(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y \to +\infty\): parabola upar khulta hai (seedha pyala).
Kyun: bari \(|x|\) par \(x^{2}\) wala term haavi hota hai, aur us ka sign \(a\) ka sign hai.

Step 4: y-intercept
\[y = (-1)(1) = -1\]
y-intercept: \((0, -1)\).
Kyun: y-axis par \(x = 0\) hota hai, wohi rakha. Dhyan dein: y-intercept aur vertex ko aapas mein na milayein; y-intercept hamesha \(x = 0\) par hota hai, jab ke vertex axis of symmetry par.

Sketch
In points ko plot karein aur smooth U-shape curve se jor dein (answer figure dekhiye). Roots \(\pm\frac{1}{2} = \pm 0.5\) hain, is liye x-axis par chhota scale (0.5 unit) lein, warna graph bahut tang dikhega.
Kyun: intercepts, vertex aur direction mil kar parabola ko tay kar dete hain. Har important point par coordinates zaroor likhein; exam mein inhi ke marks hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[y(1) = (1)(3) = 3\]
\[y(-1) = (-3)(-1) = 3 \;\checkmark\]
Doosra tareeqa: \((2x - 1)(2x + 1) = 4x^{2} - 1\); \(4x^{2}\) kabhi negative nahi, is liye sab se kam value \(-1\) hai jo \(x = 0\) par aati hai \(\checkmark\).
blocks.final_answer: Upar khulne wala parabola: x-intercepts \((-0.5, 0)\), \((0.5, 0)\); vertex aur y-intercept \((0, -1)\).

answer_figure.alt: Upward parabola y = (2x minus 1)(2x + 1) cutting the x-axis at (minus 0.5, 0) and (0.5, 0), vertex and y-intercept at (0, minus 1).
answer_figure.caption: Answer sketch for Exercise 1.1 Question 1 (iii): y = (2x − 1)(2x + 1) (original drawing; the answer key prints a matching graph)

blocks.prompt: 1 (iv) Sketch the graph of the following functions using the method of factorization: \(y = 2x^{2} + x - 3\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sketch ka sawal hai. Sab se pehle dekhte hain ke function factor form \(a(x - h)(x - k)\) mein hai ya laana parega.
Is mein do alag roots hain, is liye 1.1 ka Case-I lagega.
Humein chaar cheezein chahiyein: x-intercepts, vertex (roots ke bilkul darmiyan), khulne ki direction (\(a\) ke sign se) aur y-intercept.
Yeh chaar cheezein graph ka dhancha (skeleton) bana deti hain.
Phir symmetry se ek extra point le kar smooth curve banayenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(y = 2x^{2} + x - 3\).
Maloom karna: is function ka graph sketch karna.
Tareeqa: 1.1 ka Case-I (\(h \ne k\)): intercepts, \(x = \frac{h+k}{2}\) par vertex, \(a\) ka sign, aur y-intercept. Yeh tareeqa is liye aasan hai ke factor form mein roots seedhe nazar aate hain.

Factor form mein likhein
\[y = 2x^{2} + 3x - 2x - 3\]
\[= x(2x + 3) - 1(2x + 3)\]
\[= (2x + 3)(x - 1)\]
\[= 2\left(x + \tfrac{3}{2}\right)(x - 1)\]
Kyun: middle term ko torna hai: aise do numbers chahiyein jin ka product \(2 \times (-3) = -6\) aur sum \(1\) ho; woh \(3\) aur \(-2\) hain. Phir \((2x + 3)\) se 2 bahar nikala taa ke \(a\) saaf nazar aaye.
Dhyan dein: factor form mein \(x\) ka coefficient 1 hona chahiye, tab hi \(a\) sahi nazar aata hai.

Step 1: x-intercepts
\[2x + 3 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -\tfrac{3}{2}\]
\[x - 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = 1\]
Kyun: x-axis par \(y = 0\) hota hai, aur product tab hi zero hota hai jab koi ek factor zero ho. Is liye har factor ko zero rakha.
Dhyan dein: factor ke andar ka sign root mein ulta ho jata hai.

Step 2: vertex
\[x = \dfrac{-\frac{3}{2} + 1}{2} = -\dfrac{1}{4}\]
\[y = 2\left(\tfrac{5}{4}\right)\left(-\tfrac{5}{4}\right)\]
\[= -\dfrac{25}{8} = -3.125\]
Vertex: \(\left(-\frac{1}{4}, -\frac{25}{8}\right) = (-0.25, -3.125)\).
Kyun: parabola apni axis ke dono taraf ek jaisa hota hai, is liye vertex dono roots ke bilkul darmiyan (average par) aata hai. Phir wohi \(x\) function mein rakh kar height nikali.

Step 3: kinaron ka rawaiya
\(a = 2 > 0\), is liye \(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y \to +\infty\): parabola upar khulta hai (seedha pyala).
Kyun: bari \(|x|\) par \(x^{2}\) wala term haavi hota hai, aur us ka sign \(a\) ka sign hai.

Step 4: y-intercept
\[y = 2(0)^{2} + 0 - 3 = -3\]
y-intercept: \((0, -3)\).
Kyun: y-axis par \(x = 0\) hota hai, wohi rakha. Dhyan dein: y-intercept aur vertex ko aapas mein na milayein; y-intercept hamesha \(x = 0\) par hota hai, jab ke vertex axis of symmetry par.

Sketch
In points ko plot karein aur smooth U-shape curve se jor dein (answer figure dekhiye). Vertex y-axis se zara sa left hai aur y-intercept se thora sa neeche; graph banate waqt is farq ko dikhaiye.
Kyun: intercepts, vertex aur direction mil kar parabola ko tay kar dete hain. Har important point par coordinates zaroor likhein; exam mein inhi ke marks hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[y\left(-\tfrac{1}{2}\right) = \tfrac{1}{2} - \tfrac{1}{2} - 3 = -3 \;\checkmark\]
\[-\dfrac{b}{2a} = -\dfrac{1}{4} \;\checkmark\]
Symmetry \(x = -\frac{1}{4}\) ke gird: \((0, -3)\) ka aaina \(\left(-\frac{1}{2}, -3\right)\) hai; aur vertex ka formula \(-\frac{b}{2a}\) bhi wohi \(x\) deta hai.
blocks.final_answer: Upar khulne wala parabola: x-intercepts \((-1.5, 0)\), \((1, 0)\); vertex \((-0.25, -3.125)\); y-intercept \((0, -3)\).

answer_figure.caption: Answer sketch for Exercise 1.1 Question 1 (iv): y = 2x² + x − 3 (original drawing; the answer key prints a matching graph)

blocks.prompt: 1 (v) Sketch the graph of the following functions using the method of factorization: \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x + 1\)
blocks.explanation:
Yeh sketch ka sawal hai jis mein factor repeated (do dafa) hai: shakal \(a(x - h)^{2}\).
Is liye 1.1 ka Case-II lagega.
Aisa graph x-axis ko \(x = h\) par sirf chhoota hai, paar nahi karta, aur wohi point vertex hota hai.
Phir Case-I ke Step 3 (direction) aur Step 4 (y-intercept) lagayenge.
Aakhir mein symmetry se ek extra point le kar curve mukammal karenge.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(f(x) = x^{2} + 2x + 1\).
Maloom karna: is function ka graph sketch karna.
Tareeqa: 1.1 ka Case-II: \(a(x - h)^{2}\) ka graph x-axis ko \((h, 0)\) par chhoota hai aur yahi vertex hai; phir Steps 3 aur 4.

Factor form mein likhein
\[f(x) = x^{2} + 2x + 1 = (x + 1)^{2}\]
Kyun: \(x^{2} + 2x + 1\) perfect square \((x + 1)^{2}\) hai (\((p+q)^{2} = p^{2} + 2pq + q^{2}\) se). Yani \(a = 1\) aur \(h = k = -1\): dono factors ek jaise, is liye Case-II.
Dhyan dein: factor form mein \(x\) ka coefficient 1 hona chahiye, tab hi \(a\) sahi nazar aata hai.

Step 1: chhoone wala point (vertex)
\[x + 1 = 0 \Rightarrow x = -1\]
Graph x-axis ko \((-1, 0)\) par chhoota hai, aur yahi vertex hai.
Kyun: square kabhi negative nahi hota, is liye \(y\) ka sign \(x = h\) ke dono taraf ek hi rehta hai aur \(y\) sirf yahan zero hota hai. Graph neeche aa kar axis ko chhoota hai aur wapas chala jata hai.

Step 3: kinaron ka rawaiya
\(a = 1 > 0\), is liye \(x \to \pm\infty\) par \(y \to +\infty\): parabola upar khulta hai (seedha pyala).
Kyun: bari \(|x|\) par \(x^{2}\) wala term haavi hota hai, aur us ka sign \(a\) ka sign hai.

Step 4: y-intercept
\[f(0) = (0 + 1)^{2} = 1\]
y-intercept: \((0, 1)\).
Kyun: y-axis par \(x = 0\) hota hai, wohi rakha. Dhyan dein: y-intercept aur vertex ko aapas mein na milayein; y-intercept hamesha \(x = 0\) par hota hai, jab ke vertex axis of symmetry par.

Sketch
In points ko plot karein aur smooth U-shape curve se jor dein (answer figure dekhiye). 
Kyun: intercepts, vertex aur direction mil kar parabola ko tay kar dete hain. Har important point par coordinates zaroor likhein; exam mein inhi ke marks hain.

Tasdeeq:
\[f(-2) = (-1)^{2} = 1 \;\checkmark\]
Symmetry \(x = -1\) ke gird: \((0, 1)\) ka aaina \((-2, 1)\) hai, aur \(f(-2) = 1\) bhi aata hai.
blocks.final_answer: Upar khulne wala parabola jo x-axis ko apne vertex \((-1, 0)\) par chhoota hai; y-intercept \((0, 1)\).

answer_figure.alt: Upward parabola f(x) = x squared + 2x + 1 touching the x-axis at its vertex (minus 1, 0) and crossing the y-axis at (0, 1).
answer_figure.caption: Answer sketch for Exercise 1.1 Question 1 (v): f(x) = x² + 2x + 1 (original drawing; the answer key prints a matching graph)
